$comment: Copy and metadata for the careers and internships page.

seo.title: Careers & Internships | EireTech360 Ireland
seo.description: Explore career and internship opportunities with EireTech360's Ireland chapter, for curious people ready to learn, contribute and grow.

hero.title: Build your [g]first meaningful chapter.[/g]
hero.subtitle: The EireTech360 Ireland chapter welcomes students, graduates and early-career talent who want practical exposure to digital work, thoughtful collaboration and a clear place to grow.

ireland.label: Ireland vision
ireland.title: A warmer start for emerging talent.
ireland.body: We want our Ireland chapter to be a welcoming place for people with curiosity, care and ideas, especially those looking for a first meaningful step into digital work.

introduction.label: More than a line on a CV
introduction.title: Learn by contributing to work with real purpose.
introduction.body: An internship should help you understand how good work comes together. Here, the focus is on asking useful questions, building confidence and seeing how strategy, creativity and technology connect.
highlights: A chance to explore the kind of digital work that suits your strengths.
Practical feedback on your ideas, process and communication.
A supportive introduction to collaborative, client-focused thinking.

opportunities.label: Ways to explore
opportunities.title: Find a direction worth developing.
opportunities.body: Your interests may be technical, creative or strategic. These are the areas where emerging talent can begin a conversation with us.

items.title: Web & digital products
items.text: Explore how thoughtful websites and digital journeys are planned, shaped and improved for real people.

items.title: Marketing & brand
items.text: Learn how clear messaging, audience insight and consistent creative work help a brand earn attention.

items.title: AI & automation
items.text: See how practical systems can remove repetitive work and make teams more effective.

items.title: Creative collaboration
items.text: Build the communication habits that help designers, marketers and developers do stronger work together.

journey.label: A simple first step
journey.title: Start with a conversation, not a perfect application.
journey.body: You do not need to have everything figured out. Tell us what you are learning, what interests you and what you would like to develop next.

items.title: Share your direction
items.text: Introduce yourself, your interests and the kind of experience you hope to gain.

items.title: Show your curiosity
items.text: A small project, portfolio link or a thoughtful note is enough to help us understand your perspective.

items.title: Explore the fit
items.text: We can talk through the kind of contribution and learning path that makes sense for both sides.

companion.label: Volunteer with us
companion.title: Looking to give your time and skills to the community?
companion.body: Our volunteer page is for people who want to contribute to a more connected, welcoming digital future in Ireland.

cta.label: Take the first step
cta.title: Your next opportunity can begin with a short hello.
cta.body: Send us a note about where you are now and what you would like to learn. We will be glad to hear from you.
